demoAccessibility.assumptions: Hypothetical paved step-free roadside approaches within 20m where the existing access policy permits them; no other building, wall or water traversal. Each eligible building receives a nearest outdoor entrance ramp within 20m; indoor travel to it is hypothetically step-free, without surveyed indoor directions. Crossings have dropped kerbs; hypothetical bridges have lifts. Stairs remain excluded.
demoAccessibility.placement: All existing geographic crossing segments upgraded with hypothetical accessible access; shortest-first <=20m ramp connectors only between otherwise separate recorded-road components. No benchmark samples/results read.
